duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I perform ruqya (healing prayer) upon you from everything that harms you
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi arqika min kulli shay'in yu'dhika

duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. I rely upon Him
duas.transliteration: Hasbi Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.english: All praise is due to Allah by whose favor good deeds are completed
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmu as-salihat

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytani ar-rajim

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and turn to me in mercy. Indeed, You are the Ever-Returning, the Merciful
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa tub 'alayya innaka anta at-Tawwabu ar-Rahim

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
duas.english: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease for me my task
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
duas.english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا
duas.english: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, grant me righteous offspring
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min as-salihin

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wa at-tuqa wa al-'afafa wa al-ghina

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ
duas.english: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta as-Salam wa minka as-salam

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.english: In Your Name, O Allah, I die and I live
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni aslamtu nafsi ilayka

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadaka

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhi an-nushur

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا
duas.english: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
duas.english: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me what will benefit me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma infa'ni bima 'allamtani wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for her goodness and the goodness upon which You have created her
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa khayra ma jabaltaha 'alayh

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hammi wa al-hazan

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from weakness and laziness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-'ajzi wa al-kasal

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.english: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ikfini bi halalika 'an haramika wa aghnini bi fadlika 'amman siwak

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and heavy debt
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-ma'thami wa al-maghram

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
duas.english: Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it
duas.transliteration: Subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin

duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.english: We are returning with repentance, worshipping, prostrating, and praising our Lord
duas.transliteration: Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna sajiduna li rabbina hamidun

duas.arabic: صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.english: Let it be a strong fruitful rain
duas.transliteration: Sayyiban nafi'an

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
duas.english: In the name of Allah at the beginning and at the end of it
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا الطَّعَامَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi at'amani hadha at-ta'ama wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.english: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small
duas.transliteration: Rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytani ar-rajim

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for the best entering and the best exiting
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra al-mawliji wa khayra al-makhraji

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'ala Allah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the hardship and heal him, for You are the Healer
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba an-nasi adhhib al-ba'sa ishfihi wa anta ash-Shafi

duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.english: Never mind, may it be a purification, if Allah wills
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha' Allah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
duas.english: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him
duas.transliteration: Allahu Allahu Rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'a

duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum bi rahmatika astaghith

duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs
duas.transliteration: Hasbuna Allahu wa ni'ma al-wakil

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْوَحْشَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from loneliness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-wahshah

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimat Allahi at-tammati min sharri ma khalaq

duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ
duas.english: I seek protection for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous pest
duas.transliteration: U'idhu kuma bi kalimat Allahi at-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah

duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ
duas.english: May Allah bless you with His gift to you
duas.transliteration: Baraka Allahu laka fi al-mawhubi lak

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and Your power by Your might
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi 'ilmika wa astaqdiruka bi qudratik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.english: O Allah, You are Pardoning and Generous, You love to pardon, so pardon me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun karimun tuhibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ
duas.english: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels glorify due to fear of Him
duas.transliteration: Subhana alladhi yusabbihu ar-ra'du bi hamdihi

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil and evil deeds
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-khubuthi wa al-khaba'ith

duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.english: I seek Your forgiveness
duas.transliteration: Ghufranaka

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
duas.english: O Allah, as You have made my external features beautiful, make my character beautiful as well
duas.transliteration: Allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fa hassin khuluqi

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi kasani hadha ath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills
duas.transliteration: Dhahaba adh-dhama'u wa ibtalat al-'uruqu wa thabata al-ajru in sha' Allah

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and to Him is all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu yuhyi wa yumit wa huwa hayyun la yamut

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You
duas.transliteration: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the means and superiority
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihi ad-da'wati at-tammati wa as-salati al-qa'imati ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wa al-fadilah

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.english: Glory is to Allah, and all praise is to Allah, and Allah is the Greatest
duas.transliteration: Subhana Allah wa alhamdu lillah wa Allahu akbar

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give thanks to You, and to worship You in the best manner
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, and pardon me among those You have pardoned
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihdini fiman hadayta wa 'afini fiman 'afayt

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي
duas.english: O Allah, make the Quran the spring of my heart
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al al-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ
duas.english: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ighfir lahu wa irhamhu

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ
duas.english: O Allah, pardon him, have mercy on him, and honor his reception
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'afihi wa'fu 'anhu wa akrim nuzulah

duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
duas.english: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.english: O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ujurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah by whose favor good deeds are completed
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmu as-salihat

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah in all circumstances
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً
duas.english: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
duas.english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ وَالْعُجْبِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from arrogance and vanity
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-kibri wa al-'ujb

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika shay'an wa ana a'lam

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا
duas.english: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided for us
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fima razaqtana

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing and the evil of my sight
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri sam'i wa min sharri basari

duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on Your religion
duas.transliteration: Ya Muqallib al-qulub thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ
duas.english: O Allah, we place You before them
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.english: I seek forgiveness from Allah, there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him
duas.transliteration: Astaghfiru Allah alladhi la ilaha illa Huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: We have entered evening and the dominion belongs to Allah
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsa al-mulku lillah

duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: We have entered morning and the dominion belongs to Allah
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbaha al-mulku lillah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from helplessness, laziness and cowardice
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-'ajzi wa al-kasali wa al-jubni

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
duas.english: O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who are purified
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'alni min at-tawwabin wa ij'alni min al-mutatahhirin

duas.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
duas.english: Indeed, with hardship comes ease
duas.transliteration: Inna ma'a al-'usri yusra

duas.arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
duas.english: It is the decree of Allah, and what He wills, He does
duas.transliteration: Qadaru Allahi wa ma sha'a fa'al

duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbi al-Falaq

duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbi an-Nas

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا
duas.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us
duas.transliteration: Subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَقَانَا عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who gave us sweet, refreshing water to drink by His mercy
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi saqana 'adhban furatan bi rahmatihi

duas.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
duas.english: May Allah reward you with goodness
duas.transliteration: Jazaka Allahu khayra

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillah

duas.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
duas.english: May Allah have mercy on you
duas.transliteration: Yarhamuka Allah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
duas.english: O Allah, do not take me to account for what they say
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la tu'akhidhni bima yaqulun

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ
duas.english: All praise is to Allah who has spared me what He has afflicted you with
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi 'afani mimma ibtalaka bihi

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مَجْلِسِ السُّوءِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from bad company
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min majlisi as-su'

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
duas.english: O Allah, bless it for us and increase it for us
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minhu

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا
duas.english: O Allah, bless my nation in their early mornings
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik li ummati fi bukuriha

duas.arabic: مَا خَابَ مَنِ اسْتَخَارَ وَلَا نَدِمَ مَنِ اسْتَشَارَ
duas.english: He who makes istikhara will not fail, and he who seeks counsel will not regret
duas.transliteration: Ma khaba man istakhara wa la nadima man istashara

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَنَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.english: O Allah, unite us in goodness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ijma' baynana fi khayr

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that does not have humility
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min qalbin la yakhsha'

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, He has no partner
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannata wa a'udhu bika min an-nar

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduka ibnu 'abdika ibnu amatika nasiyati biyadik

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.english: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayru al-munzilin

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin wa ij'alna lil-muttaqina imama

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afiyata fi ad-dunya wa al-akhirah

duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي
duas.english: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un Allahumma ujurni fi musibati

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ عَمَلٍ لَا يُرْفَعُ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit and from deeds that are not raised
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa'u wa min 'amalin la yurfa'

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal him, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba an-nasi adhhib al-ba'sa ishfihi wa anta ash-Shafi la shifa'a illa shifa'uk

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الظُّلْمِ وَالْمَظْلَمَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from oppression and being oppressed
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adh-dhulmi wa al-madhlamah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِهِ رَحْمَةً وَعَفْوًا
duas.english: O Allah, place mercy and pardon in their heart
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al fi qalbihi rahmatan wa 'afwa

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith
duas.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir lana wa li-ikhwanina alladhina sabaquna bi al-iman

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni dhalamtu nafsi faghfir li

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wa at-tuqa wa al-'afafa wa al-ghina

duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs, the best Protector and the best Helper
duas.transliteration: Hasbuna Allahu wa ni'ma al-wakil ni'ma al-mawla wa ni'ma an-nasir

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خِرْ لِي وَاخْتَرْ لِي
duas.english: O Allah, choose what is best for me and make the choice for me
duas.transliteration: Allahumma khir li wakhtir li

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger, from the evil of His servants, and from the whisperings of the devils and that they be present with me
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa sharri 'ibadihi wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.english: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. Praise be to Allah, glory be to Allah, there is no deity but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power or might except with Allah
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Alhamdulillahi wa subhanallahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
duas.english: There is no deity but Allah, the One, the Overpowering, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahuma al-'azizul-ghaffar

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.english: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You release it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants
duas.transliteration: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uhu, in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.english: Allah: there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma, wa huwal-'aliyyul-'adhim

duas.arabic: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
duas.english: Guide us to the straight path, the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
duas.transliteration: Ihdina as-sirata al-mustaqima sirata alladhina an'amta 'alayhim ghayri al-maghdubi 'alayhim wala ad-dalina

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.english: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka anta as-sami'u al-'alimu

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.english: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana wa-ij'alna muslimayni laka wamin dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka wa-arina manasikana watub 'alayna innaka anta at-tawabu ar-rahimu

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.english: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuakhidhna in nasina aw akhtana rabbana wala tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'ala alladhina min qablina rabbana wala tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi wa-u'fu 'anna wa-ighfir lana wa-irhamna anta mawlana fa-unsurna 'ala al-qawmi al-kafirina

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.english: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wahab lana min ladunka rahmatan innaka anta al-wahabu

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna fa-ighfir lana dhunubana waqina 'adhaba an-nari

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir lana dhunubana wa-israfana fi amrina wathabbit aqdamana wa-unsurna 'ala al-qawmi al-kafirina

duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller [i.e., Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)] calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil'imani an aminu birabbikum faamanna rabbana fa-ighfir lana dhunubana wakaffir 'anna sayyiatina watawaffana ma'a al-abrari

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.english: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana waatina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wala tukhzina yawma al-qiyamati innaka la tukhlifu al-mi'ada

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِّنكَ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
duas.english: O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabbana anzil 'alayna maidatan mina as-samai takunu lana 'idan li-awwalina waakhirina waayatan minka wa-urzuqna wa-anta khayru ar-raziqina

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa-in lam taghfir lana watarhamna lanakunanna mina al-khasirina

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.english: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran watawaffana muslimina

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.english: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lilqawmi az-zalimina wanajjina birahmatika mina al-qawmi al-kafirina

duas.arabic: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi qad ataytani mina al-mulki wa'allamtani min tawili al-ahadithi fatira as-samawati wa-al-ardi anta waliyyi fi ad-dunya wa-al-akhirati tawaffani musliman wa-alhiqni bias-salihina

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.english: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ij'alni muqima as-salati wamin dhurriyyati rabbana wataqabbal du'ai rabbana ighfir li waliwalidayya walilmu'minina yawma yaqumu al-hisabu

duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.english: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.
duas.transliteration: Anni massaniya ad-durru wa-anta arhamu ar-rahimina

duas.arabic: أَن لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.english: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.transliteration: An la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu mina az-zalimina

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.english: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazati ash-shayatini wa-a'udhu bika rabbi an yahduruni

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir wa-irham wa-anta khayru ar-rahimina

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ
duas.english: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana isrif 'anna 'adhaba jahannama

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
duas.english: My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous. And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li hukman wa-alhiqni bias-salihina wa-ij'al li lisana sidqin fi al-akhirina wa-ij'alni min warathati jannati an-na'imi

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya wa'ala walidayya wa-an a'mala salihan tardahu wa-adkhilni birahmatika fi 'ibadika as-salihina

duas.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi najjini mina al-qawmi az-zalimina

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqirun

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya wa'ala walidayya wa-an a'mala salihan tardahu wa-aslih li fi dhurriyyati inni tubtu ilayka wa-inni mina al-muslimina

duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ
duas.english: Indeed, I am overpowered, so help.
duas.transliteration: Anni maghlubun fa-intasir

duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.english: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana 'alayka tawakkalna wa-ilayka anabna wa-ilayka al-masiru

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.english: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atmim lana nurana wa-ighfir lana innaka 'ala kulli shayin qadirun

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minan walilmu'minina wa-al-mu'minati wala tazidi az-zalimina illa tabaran

duas.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.english: And put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
duas.transliteration: Wala taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu rabbana innaka raufun rahimun

duas.arabic: فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
duas.english: So patience is most fitting. And Allah is the one sought for help against that which you describe.
duas.transliteration: Fasabrun jamilun wallahu al-musta'anu 'ala ma tasifuna

duas.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
duas.english: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah.
duas.transliteration: Innama ashku bathi wahuzni ila Allahi

duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.english: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa-anta khayru al-warithina

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُن بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
duas.english: My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni wahana al-'azmu minni wa-ishta'ala ar-rasu shayban walam akun bidu'aika rabbi shaqiyyan

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
duas.english: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilni mudkhala sidqin wa-akhrijni mukhraja sidqin wa-ij'al li min ladunka sultanan nasiran

duas.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.english: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.
duas.transliteration: Qul huwa allahu ahadun allahu as-samadu lam yalid walam yulad walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun

duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.english: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbi al-falaqi min sharri ma khalaqa wamin sharri ghasiqin idha waqaba wamin sharri an-nafathati fi al-'uqadi wamin sharri hasidin idha hasada

duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.english: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbi an-nasi maliki an-nasi ilahi an-nasi min sharri al-waswasi al-khanasi alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri an-nasi mina al-jinati waan-nasi

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord. You created me, and I am Your slave. I will remain faithful to Your covenant and promise as much as possible. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I admit my sin. So, forgive me. Indeed, none can forgive sins but You
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi, faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.english: O Allah! Set me apart from my sins (faults) as the East and West are set apart from each other and clean me from sins as a white garment is cleaned of dirt (after thorough washing). O Allah! Wash off my sins with water, snow and hail
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allahumma naqqini minal-khataya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas. Allahummaghsil khatayaya bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي كُلِّهِ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي
duas.english: O Lord, forgive me my sin, my ignorance, my excess in all of my affairs, and whatever You are better aware of than me
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir li khati'ati wa jahli wa israfi fi amri kullihi wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, forgive my past and future sins, my secret and open sins, my transgression, and that of which You have better knowledge than I. Indeed, You are the One Who puts forward, and You are the One Who puts back. There is no god but You.
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu wa ma asraftu wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni, antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu'akhkhiru la ilaha illa anta

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا وَفَوْقِي نُورًا وَتَحْتِي نُورًا وَأَمَامِي نُورًا وَخَلْفِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا
duas.english: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing, light on my right, light on my left, light above me, light below me, light in front of me, light behind me, make light for me!
duas.transliteration: Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi basari nuran, wa fi sam'i nuran, wa 'an yamini nuran, wa 'an yasari nuran, wa fawqi nuran, wa tahti nuran, wa amami nuran, wa khalfi nuran, waj'al li nuran

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the removal of Your favor, the change of Your well-being, the suddenness of Your calamity, and all of Your wrath.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matika wa tahawwuli 'afiyatika wa fuja'ati niqmatika wa jami'i sakhatika

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
duas.english: O Allah, set right for me my religion that is the safeguard of my affairs, and set right for me my world wherein my living is, and set right for me my Hereafter wherein my return is, and make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li dini alladhi huwa 'ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyaya allati fiha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhirati allati fiha ma'adi, waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
duas.english: O Allah, guide me and make me adhere to the straight path
duas.transliteration: Allahummahdini wa saddidni

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ
duas.english: O Allah, I surrender to You, I believe in You, I rely upon You, to You I repent, and with Your help I dispute. I seek refuge in Your Might. There is no god but You, that You do not lead me astray. You are the Ever-Living Who never dies, but the Jinn and humans die
duas.transliteration: Allahumma laka aslamtu wa bika amantu wa 'alayka tawakkaltu wa ilayka anabtu wa bika khasamtu. Allahumma inni a'udhu bi'izzatika la ilaha illa anta an tudillani. Antal-hayyul-ladhi la yamutu wal-jinnu wal-insu yamutun

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ
duas.english: I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I did and from the evil of what I did not
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'amiltu wa min sharri ma lam a'mal

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.english: I seek refuge with Allah and His power from the evil that I find and fear
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru

duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.english: I ask Allah the Great, Lord of the great Throne, to cure you
duas.transliteration: As'alullahal-'azima rabbal-'arshil-'azimi an yashfiyak

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing in the earth or the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim

duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, with Islam as a religion, with Muhammad as a Messenger
duas.transliteration: Raditu billahi rabban wa bil-islami dinan wa bi-muhammadin rasula

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.english: There is no god but Allah, the Most Great, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, the Lord of the heavens, the Lord of the earth, and the Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'azimul-halim, la ilaha illallahu rabbul-'arshil-'azim, la ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-'arshil-karim

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.english: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah, our Lord. O Allah, forgive me
duas.transliteration: Subhanaka allahumma rabbana wa bihamdika, allahummaghfir li

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, the small and the great, the first and the last, the public and the private
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
duas.english: O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the trial of life and death and from the evil of the trial of Masih al-Dajjal
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannama wa min 'adhabil-qabri wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamati wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.english: O Allah, I have wronged myself much, and none forgives sins except You. So forgive me with forgiveness from You, and have mercy upon me, indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indika warhamni innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of Jibril, Mikha'il, and Israfil, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your slaves concerning that in which they used to differ. Guide me, by Your permission, to the truth about which people differ. Verily, You guide whom You will to the straight path!
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabba jibra'ila wa mika'ila wa israfil, fatiras-samawati wal-ardi, 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifun. Ihdini lima khtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi-idhnik, innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratim-mustaqim

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعاً نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ عَاجِلًا غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
duas.english: O Allah! give us rain which will replenish us, abundant, fertilising and profitable, not injurious, granting it now without delay
duas.transliteration: Allahummasqina ghaythan mughithan mari'an mari'an nafi'an ghayra darrin 'ajilan ghayra ajil

duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ
duas.english: Peace be upon you, abode of a people who are believers. What you were promised would come to you tomorrow, you receiving it after some delay; and God willing we shall join you
duas.transliteration: Assalamu 'alaykum dara qawmin mu'minin, wa ataakum ma tu'adun ghadan mu'ajjalun, wa inna in sha'allahu bikum lahiqun

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.english: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them as a sustenance; and forgive them and have mercy upon them
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum waghfir lahum warhamhum

duas.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الأَبْرَارُ وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
duas.english: May the fasting people break their fast in your house, and may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels ask forgiveness and mercy for you.
duas.transliteration: Aftara 'indakumus-sa'imun, wa akala ta'amakumul-abrar, wa sallat 'alaykumul-mala'ikah

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for its good and the good of what is in it and the good of the purpose for which it was sent; and I seek Your refuge from its evil and the evil of what is in it and the evil of the purpose for which it was sent.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa khayra ma fiha wa khayra ma ursilat bih, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ursilat bih

duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.english: I testify that there is no god but Allah, the One, there is no associate with Him and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger
duas.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.english: O Allah, by You we have reached the morning, and by You we have reached the evening; by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the Resurrection.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur

duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.english: May Allah bless for you, and may He bless on you, and combine both of you in good (works)
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu laka wa baraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الأَخْلَاقِ وَالأَعْمَالِ وَالأَهْوَاءِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from evil morals, deeds, and desires
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min munkaratil-akhlaqi wal-a'mali wal-ahwa'

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from knowledge that is not beneficial, from a heart that does not fear, from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa', wa min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ
duas.english: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness from geriatric old age, from being in debt, and from committing sins
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kasali wal-harami wal-maghrami wal-ma'tham
